parameters.query:
select
  (select count(*) from page_index_status where status = 'ok') as ok_files,
  (select count(*) from page_index_status where status = 'failed') as failed_files,
  (select count(*) from page_index_status where status in ('queued', 'indexing') and updated_at < now() - interval '2 hours') as stuck_files,
  (select count(*) from document_metadata m
    where lower(substring(m.file_name from '\.([^./]+)$')) in ('pdf','docx','doc','pptx','jpg','jpeg','png','tif','tiff')
      and m.file_name !~* '(^|/)old_|do not use'
      and not exists (select 1 from page_index_status s where s.file_id = m.file_id and s.status = 'ok'
                      and s.content_hash is not distinct from m.content_hash)) as not_indexed,
  (select count(*) from page_views) as views,
  (select string_agg(left(file_name, 60) || ': ' || left(coalesce(message, ''), 90), E'\n')
     from (select file_name, message from page_index_status where status = 'failed' order by updated_at desc limit 3) f) as failed_examples

parameters.content:
## Vision health (every 2 hours)
Checks the local vision service and the page index. Sends a Telegram alert only when the service is down, files failed to index, or files are stuck in the queue; the 8:00 run always sends a one-line summary.
